Point Node's test runner at the cart test file directly:

```sh
node --test tests/cart.test.ts
```

Don't use `npm test -- tests/cart.test.ts`. The `test` script already includes the `tests/*.test.ts` glob, so npm would add your file on top of it and still run every test.

To run specific tests by name (inside the cart file or across all files), use:

```sh
node --test --test-name-pattern="cart" tests/cart.test.ts
```

This needs Node 22.18 or newer, as `package.json` requires. That version runs `.ts` files directly, so you don't need a build step.
